headline: S&P 500 futures fall as U.S.-Iran truce expires, yields spike
summary: S&P 500 futures fell as the US-Iran truce expired, while the 30-year Treasury yield reached its highest level since 2007. Oil climbed and chip stocks dragged Nasdaq futures lower.
why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies, and the 30-year Treasury yield sets long-term borrowing costs across the economy.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The index futures fell directly on the reported move after the truce expiry.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
